Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning unattended pet animals with a choke chain.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to unattended pet animals with a choke chain;adding a new section to chapter 9.08 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 18.92 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.240 RCW; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person engaged in the business of caring for or medicallytreating a pet animal who leaves the animal unattended while the animalis secured around the neck with a choke chain, and who injures or killsthe pet animal is guilty of a misdemeanor punishable according tochapter 9A.20 RCW and by a mandatory fine of not less than five hundreddollars per animal.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.92 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person licensed under this chapter is prohibited from leavingany pet animal with a choke chain unattended.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.240 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person licensed under this chapter is prohibited from leavingany pet animal with a choke chain unattended.
